name: quhip
description: Cookieless, privacy-first web analytics with heatmaps and element CTR on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.build: pnpm run build:snippet && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir dist
scripts.db:reset: wrangler d1 execute quhip-db --local --file=migrations/0000_reset.sql && wrangler d1 execute quhip-db --local --file=migrations/0001_initial_schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute quhip-db --local --file=migrations/0002_seed_local_test.sql
